findings.detail: Keep the existing global KOP resource parser. opt-parser=false applies only to the new native aggregate resources; original Surge modules, raw-JS imports and subtitle filtering still need their original parser settings.
Both TestFlightAccount.js and TestFlightDownload.conf are enabled. The current original author explicitly asks users of the merged Account script to disable the older regional-download script.
Preserve #out=Hant and opt-parser=true from the user's active subtitle resource. This is parser filtering, not a fragment that may be discarded.
Original ten service routes and their named policies are not completely replaced by the optional blackmatrix lists. Keep original routing until a semantic migration is verified.

The two original RuleGo modules and the original Limbo web rewrite are not completely migrated. Of 113 RuleGo plain-reject candidates, 78 are text-identical to current output and 35 differ; this is not proof that the latter are all unblocked.
The active old fmz chongxie URL is 404. The new native ad profile reads the author's current rewrite.snippet; the original update-interval=-1 cache cannot be recovered from this config alone.
Preserve current 18 enabled and 7 disabled rewrite resources. Six disabled original raw files are 404; the disabled old price wrapper is readable but its external script download failed.
Collections includes both ad cleanup and entitlement changes and prohibits republication. Its source object and actual script repositories are recorded; its body is not copied into this public audit.

coverage_statement: This is a complete direct-reference inventory and a recorded coverage comparison, not a claim that all configuration functions were merged or tested on iOS. Personal node, subscription, certificate and local rule values are not published.
